name: Laura's Kitchen Taste of New York
address: 615 W Bloomingdale Ave, Brandon, FL 33511, United States
photos_note: 11 fotos reales descargadas de la ficha de Google Maps (place URL confirmado por el usuario). gmaps-1 y gmaps-2 son duplicados exactos (mismo md5): se uso solo gmaps-1. gmaps-9 es una botella de jugo Tropicana sobre fondo blanco, sin valor para el site (no aporta nada apetitoso ni de marca): se descarto de la curaduria. Las 9 fotos restantes (gmaps-1,3,4,5,6,7,8,10,11) son comida real o el food truck mismo, nitidas, sin selfies ni texto de pantalla superpuesto: gmaps-1 (chicken cutlet sandwich cortado), gmaps-3 (el food truck con sus dos pizarras de menu del dia y el letrero 'Lunch Menu' con precios reales, foto clave para research de menu), gmaps-4 y gmaps-5 (sandwiches de desayuno: huevo/tocino/jamon y pork roll/huevo/queso), gmaps-6 (3 tiras de pollo frito con papas), gmaps-7 (sausage and peppers), gmaps-8 (chicken cutlet BLT), gmaps-10 (sandwich de pollo empanizado con lechuga y tomate), gmaps-11 (sandwich tipo cubano prensado con cerdo, jamon y queso). 9 fotos reales y distintas usadas en el site, por encima del minimo de 5.

reviewSamples.author: Rich Christoph
reviewSamples.text: First of, they're great. Always smiling and happy making food fresh to order. Secondly, the food, wow, the chicken cutlet is AMAZING. We're talking top 3 cutlet sandwich. Try the BLT Cutlet it's the best. You won't regret anything on the menu.

reviewSamples.author: J C
reviewSamples.text: If you're a New Yorker living in Florida and you've been missing that REAL New York taste, you NEED to find this food truck!

reviewSamples.author: Nayelli Padilla
reviewSamples.text: Super good I definitely recommend, they have great prices and great customer service. You can taste the love they put into their food.

reviewSamples.author: Cheikhou Fass Toure
reviewSamples.text: Laura's Kitchen Taste of New York is fantastic! Everything I've tried has been delicious, and they offer plenty of breakfast and lunch options to choose from. The quality of the food is consistently great, and the menu has something for everyone.

reviewSamples.author: javier casado
reviewSamples.text: We couldn't eat there, we had to give up. We were on the line for about 20 minutes and it didn't even move one inch. A couple of folks were verbally fighting in front of us about who was first. Next time they would have do something to help taking orders and have some pre-cooked food, it was a bad food truck experience

nombre: Laura's Kitchen Taste of New York
cuisine_real: Puerto Rican / Italian cuisine, New York deli style (texto verbatim en la rotulacion del propio food truck: 'Laura's Kitchen Taste of New York - Puerto Rican / Italian Cuisine - Authentic flavor straight from New York').

menu_real.fuente: Fotografiado directamente de dos pizarras de tiza ('Lunch Hero' en ingles y 'Almuerzo' en espanol) y del letrero blanco 'Lunch Menu' pegado al costado del food truck, visibles en gmaps-3.jpg. Precios verbatim del negocio, no inventados.

items.name: Chicken Cutlet BLT with Chipotle Sauce

menu_real.breakfast_note: Las reseñas (Cheikhou Fass Toure) mencionan 'plenty of breakfast and lunch options'. Las fotos gmaps-4 y gmaps-5 muestran sandwiches de desayuno reales (huevo/tocino/jamon/queso y pork roll/huevo/queso) pero las pizarras fotografiadas solo traian precios de almuerzo, asi que el site NO inventa precio de desayuno: usa framing 'llama para precios y disponibilidad del dia'.

website_checked: Confirmado sin website propio. node scripts/_gmaps_url_detail.js contra el place URL exacto confirmo name/address/phone/rating/reviews y website: null. Se probaron 9 variantes de dominio (lauraskitchenny.com, lauraskitchentasteofnewyork.com, lauraskitchenbrandon.com, lauraskitchenflorida.com, lauraskitchentasteofny.com, laurakitchenny.com, laurakitchentasteofnewyork.com, laurakitchenbrandon.com, laurakitchenflorida.com): las 9 devuelven curl 000 (sin resolucion DNS). 4 busquedas WebSearch (nombre+ciudad+food truck, nombre+instagram+menu, nombre+telefono, site:instagram.com+nombre+tampa/brandon/florida) no encontraron Instagram, Facebook, Yelp ni dominio propio: el negocio no tiene presencia web indexada mas alla de la ficha de Google Maps.

ig_source: Multiples WebSearch (nombre+ciudad+food truck, nombre+instagram+menu, site:instagram.com+variantes, nombre+telefono) no localizaron ninguna cuenta de Instagram o Facebook propia verificable de 'Laura's Kitchen Taste of New York'. Sin perfil social encontrado.
contact_channel: Telefono publico en Google Maps y rotulado en el propio food truck: +1 813-440-0220 (unico canal de contacto publico encontrado; tambien visible impreso en las pizarras de menu). Se usa como canal principal de CTA (llamar / enviar mensaje de texto).
owner_name: Laura (nombre del negocio; no se confirmo apellido ni si es la dueña activa en las reseñas)
evidenced_regular_location_note: La ficha de Google Maps expone una direccion fija (615 W Bloomingdale Ave, Brandon, FL 33511) con horario semanal regular (Lun-Vie 9-4, Sab 10-5), consistente con un food truck/trailer que opera en una ubicacion fija y reconocida, no un catering movil sin base. Por eso el site usa un mapa embebido real en vez de solo una foto.
